## Out-of-scope check

The following are **out of scope** for this free repository (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`):

- Adding new chapters beyond the five in the free edition
- Editing `MANIFEST-full.yaml`
- Commercial-use brand assets
- Voice / style overhauls

If your request is one of the above, please open a discussion rather than an issue.
